name: Paper.js
role: Vector scene graph with Bezier path geometry and boolean path operations
summary: Vector graphics scripting framework on Canvas, built around paths, segments and curves. Offers boolean operations, offsetting, hit testing, path flattening and intersection, plus SVG import/export. Driven by PaperScript or JavaScript; output is Canvas pixels or SVG. Its strength is geometric path computation that other canvas libraries lack.
use_when: Boolean union, intersection and subtraction of vector shapes
Over Two.js when you need path geometry, not just drawing
Computing path length, points and offsets for motion or morphing
SVG import, edit and export of paths in script
avoid_when: Interactive scene graph with events: Konva
Animated SVG on a timeline: GSAP with svg
notes: 2026-10-26: paperjs.org returned only navigation text; headless Node use (paper-jsdom or canvas) and feature list were not verified from it.

assessment.rationale: GitHub release v0.16.0 on 2026-10-21; MIT per npm. Boolean path ops and curve geometry are unique among the A1 neighbours.

evidence.result: 90 distinct 1280x720 alpha frames at 30 fps; all shuffled hashes equal sequential in one record and one verify run; frame 45 alpha min 0 max 1. Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, Node 22.19.0; screenshot route. Contact sheet and native frame inspected.
evidence.scope: Smoothed path, boolean union and radial gradient set from t with explicit view.update(); alpha PNG; macOS arm64 Chromium. No SVG, PaperScript, hit testing or interaction.
